# gitmoap_repository_tag_rule (Data Source)

Read one of a repository's tag rules. One of the rules the repository declares itself: its pattern, the level needed to create, move or delete a matching tag, and when it changed. Anyone who can see the repository may read it.

The token needs `tag_rule:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) The repository's id
- `tag_rule_id` (String) The tag rule's id

### Read-Only

- `allowed_to_create` (String)
- `created_at` (String) When the rule was created.
- `enforcement` (String) Whether the scopes beneath may replace a rule, or only strengthen it.
- `scope_id` (String) The repository or group the rule is attached to.
- `scope_type` (String)
- `tag_pattern` (String) The tags a tag rule protects: one tag name, or a glob over tag names such as `v*` or `release-*`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the rule last changed.
